intro: Lanka Farshot is a tauren hunter trainer stationed at Camp Narache within the Red Cloud Mesa. He guides novice tauren hunters as they take their first steps in tracking, marksmanship, and surviving the plains of Mulgore.

sections.t: Mentor of the Red Cloud Mesa
p: Standing watch over Camp Narache, Lanka Farshot greets new tauren called to the path of the hunter. Fresh recruits arrive carrying an etched note directing them to seek his counsel. Under his steady eye, apprentices learn the fundamentals of ranged combat, tracking prey, and respecting the wild beasts that roam the grassy plains of Mulgore. His teachings ensure that every young hunter serves as a capable scout and provider for the tribe.
